youtube_title: Same ₹10, LESS Biscuit 🍪 The Shrinkflation Trick #Shorts
youtube_description:
The ₹10 biscuit pack went from 140g to 110g. Same price. A 100g noodle pack became 70g, and the price went from ₹10 to ₹12.

This is SHRINKFLATION: companies keep the price you remember and quietly cut the grams.

Rule: ignore the front price, read the NET WEIGHT on the back, and compare price per gram.

Source: ThePrint, 'You're not imagining it', May 2022.
